simple.meaning: מַתְכֹנֶת (mathkôneth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “proportion (in size, number or ingredients).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 5:8. The surrounding context includes sacrifice.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַתְכֹנֶת (H4971) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַתְכֹנֶת (mathkôneth) / H4971 is traced through Exodus 5:8, Exodus 30:32, Exodus 30:37, 2 Chronicles 24:13 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’

timeline.evidenceText: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’
It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.
The incense which you shall make, according to its composition you shall not make for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.
So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.

The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer,‡ 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.

definitions.full: H4971. mathkoneth or mathkuneth מַתְכֹּ֫נֶת noun feminine measurement, tale, proportion ; — 1 construct ׳מ הַלְּבֵנִים Exod 5:3 (J) the tale of bricks (compare 1. תֹּכֶן ). 2 suffix בֻּנְתּוֺ - measurement, proportion , of ephah and bath Ezek 45:11 ; of composition of sacred oil Exod 30:32 , תָּהּ - 30:37 (P); of temple, its measurement, proportion תּוֺ - 2Chr 24:13 . תַּכְּרִיךְ see כרך . תֵּל and compounds see תלל .
definitions.rootNote: or מַתְכֻנֶת ; from 8505 in the transferred sense of measuring;
